fields.Name: T127 - Admin Query Browser
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Data & Schema > Query Browser sub-section renders the query tree and run area without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Data & Schema' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Query Browser' sub-section. The success state is the query browser rendering with a query tree/list and a query run area. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the view to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Data & Schema section open and the Query Browser sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
The query browser renders showing a query tree/list and an area to run or view a query
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
